tooltip.scythes.blood_blender.desc: Right click in the air pulls enemy targets within 3 blocks toward you, deals damage equal to 2 basic scythe attacks, inflicts Slowness II for 4 seconds, and inflicts Bleeding II for 10 seconds. Ignores teammates, pets, and neutral mobs. If there are no nearby targets, the ability does not activate.

tooltip.scythes.blood_harvest.desc: Marks enemy players within 10 blocks for 20 seconds. Costs 100 durability and has a 60-second cooldown. Kill during the window for 16 seconds of Speed II, Strength II, and Regeneration II; fail and receive 7.5 seconds of Slowness II, Weakness II, and Blindness.

tooltip.scythes.bloody_scythe.desc: A cursed endgame scythe for relentless melee pressure: 40% bleed chance, 25% vampirism chance, a 20% chance to partially pierce defenses, and Blood Harvest for finishing marked players.
tooltip.scythes.bloody_scythe.passive.de: On hit: 40% chance to inflict Bleeding for at least 2 seconds. Bleeding deals true damage and ignores armor, Protection, and resistance. Vampirism has a 25% chance to heal 50% of actual damage dealt, with a 1-second delay between successful heals. It also has a 20% chance to ignore 50% of the target's damage mitigation.

tooltip.scythes.toxic_scythe.base_stats: Base stats: same damage tier and attack speed as the Bloody Scythe.
tooltip.scythes.toxic_scythe.desc: A brutal anti-armor scythe: its basic attacks corrode equipment and spread Poison II, while its orb and aura punish clustered enemies.
tooltip.scythes.toxic_scythe.passive.des: On hit: 30% chance to deal 20 durability damage to the target's entire armor set, and 25% chance to inflict Poison II for 2 seconds.
tooltip.scythes.toxic_orb.desc: Right click launches a toxic orb with a 5-second cooldown. It costs 20 durability, bursts in a 2-block radius, deals 2 armor-piercing damage, inflicts Poison II for 10 seconds, and deals 30 durability damage to the whole armor set.
tooltip.scythes.toxic_aura.desc: Activates for 10 seconds with a 60-second cooldown and costs 100 durability. Within 5 blocks it refreshes Poison II for 10 seconds, damages armor every tick, and can trigger armor-piercing damage or Nausea.

tooltip.scythes.withering_scythe.base_st: Base stats: same damage tier and attack speed as the Bloody and Toxic scythes.
tooltip.scythes.withering_scythe.desc: A necromantic endgame scythe: harvests souls from the fallen, spreads Wither II, summons wither-skeleton minions, and empowers them with a dark aura.
tooltip.scythes.withering_scythe.passive: On hit: 30% chance to inflict Wither II for 10 seconds. Killing a mob stores 1 soul; killing a player stores 12 souls.
tooltip.scythes.withering_minion.desc: Right click in the air summons a nearby wither-skeleton minion for 10 durability and 6 souls. Minions follow their owner, defend them, passively regenerate by consuming scythe durability, and vanish after 15 minutes. Shift+right click dismisses all of your minions. The base minion cap is 6 and can be increased with Additional Slot.
tooltip.scythes.withering_aura.desc: Activates for 10 seconds with a 60-second cooldown and costs 100 durability. Within 5 blocks it refreshes Wither II for 10 seconds, while your minions within 10 blocks receive refreshed Strength II and Speed II for 3 seconds.

advancement.scythes.merciless.desc: Kill a target after using the Bloody Scythe passive, active, and special ability on it.
advancement.scythes.impossible_intoxicat: Use the Toxic Scythe to keep one target poisoned for 22 seconds.
enchantment.scythes.additional_slot.desc: Increases the Withering Scythe minion cap: +1, +2, +4.
enchantment.scythes.soul_siphon.desc: Has a 50% chance to double souls gained from Withering Scythe kills.
enchantment.scythes.acidity.desc: Increases armor damage from Toxic Scythe skills by 11% per level.
tooltip.scythes.golden_scythe.base_stats: Base stats: same damage tier and attack speed as the other endgame scythes.
tooltip.scythes.golden_scythe.desc: A lavish reaper's scythe of fortune: improves Looting, pacifies piglins, punishes one target with Midas Touch, and covers enemies in golden marks for richer drops.
tooltip.scythes.golden_scythe.passive.de: While the Golden Scythe is held in either hand, it adds +1 Looting level and counts as a golden item for piglin neutrality. The bonus does not stack from multiple Golden Scythes.
tooltip.scythes.midas_touch.desc: Right click a target within reach to spend 50 durability with a 40-second cooldown. The touch deals true damage equal to 50% of the target's max health, minimum 20 and maximum 100. The target receives a golden mark: if it dies from this hit or later by the mark owner, its loot is rolled with +2 additional Looting levels.
tooltip.scythes.golden_rain.desc: The active ability costs 100 durability and has a 2.5-minute cooldown. It marks every valid target within 20 blocks with gold; each mark adds +2 Looting levels to that target's future drops for the mark owner.
tooltip.scythes.stat.piglin_neutrality: Piglins are neutral while the scythe is held in either hand
tooltip.scythes.stat.no_golden_scythe_st: Multiple Golden Scythes do not stack the passive bonus

tooltip.scythes.frozen_scythe.base_stats: Base stats: same damage tier and attack speed as the other endgame scythes.
tooltip.scythes.frozen_scythe.desc: A frost scythe that commands ice. It lets its wielder traverse powder snow, freeze water, strike enemies with ice spikes, and summon a freezing storm.
tooltip.scythes.frozen_scythe.passive.de: While the Frost Scythe is anywhere in the inventory, its owner can walk on powder snow. While held in either hand, it freezes water like Frost Walker II. On hit, it has a 33% chance to apply Freezing for 1 second.

tooltip.scythes.ice_spike.desc: Right click to fire an ice spike in the direction you are looking at the speed of a fully drawn arrow. On hit it deals 10 damage and applies Freezing for 1.5 seconds. The ability costs 30 durability and has a 20-second cooldown.

tooltip.scythes.frozen_storm.desc: Summons a freezing storm in a 20-block radius. Every valid target receives Freezing for 5 seconds plus Slowness and Weakness for 10 seconds. It costs 100 durability, has a 40-second cooldown, and does not affect pets or teammates.
